statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic palpitations with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess for ischemic changes related to the patient's known coronary artery disease
The claim was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
